text: DGX B300 is a single platform for accelerating both LLM training and inference
quote: DGX B300 provides enterprises with a single platform to accelerate large language model (LLM) inference and training.

text: Delivers 72 PFLOPS of FP8 training and 144 PFLOPS of FP4 inference throughput
quote: 72 PFLOPS FP8 training; 144 PFLOPS FP4 inference

text: System has 8 Blackwell Ultra B300 GPUs with 288 GB each, 2.3 TB of GPU memory in total
quote: 8 x NVIDIA B300 Blackwell Ultra GPUs ... GPU memory 8 x 288 GB = 2.3 TB total

text: Dense FP4 performance is 1.5x and attention performance is 2x higher than DGX B200
quote: DGX B300 boosts dense FP4 performance by 1.5x and attention performance by 2x over DGX B200

text: Offered in both AC/PDU and DC/busbar power versions
quote: Available in both AC/PDU and DC/busbar versions.

text: Includes 12 power supply units in an N+N redundant configuration for continuous operation
quote: The system includes 12 power supply units (PSU) configured for N+N redundancy, ensuring continuous operation and power reliability.

text: Fits NVIDIA MGX and traditional enterprise racks and ships with a full software stack for AI deployment
quote: Compatible with NVIDIA MGX™ and traditional enterprise racks and with full-stack software, it simplifies and streamlines AI deployment

text: BMC provides remote KVM, remote storage, and Redfish/IPMI out-of-band management
quote: Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) ... Remote keyboard, video, mouse (KVM) ... Remote storage ... RedFish, IPMI management

text: Supports up to 4 TB of system RAM, expandable on-site with 128 GB DIMMs
quote: Supports up to 4 TB of RAM, configurable on-site with 128 GB DIMMs purchased from NVIDIA.

text: Runs DGX OS 7 (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS), with added support for Ubuntu, RHEL 8/9, and Rocky Linux
quote: DGX OS 7 based on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS; Additional support for Ubuntu and Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 and 9, Rocky Linux

text: Cluster networking uses 8 ConnectX-8 cards with 8 x 800 Gb/s InfiniBand/Ethernet ports
quote: 8 x OSFP ports provide connectivity to 8 x NVIDIA® ConnectX®-8 cards (cluster network); 8 x 800 Gb/s InfiniBand/Ethernet

text: Cache storage of 8 x 3.84 TB E1.S NVMe self-encrypting drives
quote: Cache storage: 8 x E1.S 3.84 TB NVMe self-encrypting drives

text: Front-facing I/O and motherboard/GPU trays on sliding rails for easier servicing
quote: All I/O connectivity is moved to the front of the system. ... The motherboard and GPU trays are installed on sliding rails for easy access.

text: Scales into DGX SuperPOD infrastructure for the largest AI training and inference workloads
quote: DGX SuperPOD provides leadership-class accelerated infrastructure with scalable performance for the most demanding AI training and inference workloads

text: Has a documented guide for tuning CUDA kernels on the Blackwell GPU architecture
quote: Use this guide when tuning CUDA kernels for Blackwell GPU architectures.

text: Deploys models larger than one node on Kubernetes using LeaderWorkerSets or MPI through Helm values
quote: deploy a model that exceeds the GPU capacity of a single node ... and you are using Kubernetes, so you can configure LeaderWorkerSets or MPI with the proper Helm values

text: Uses NVIDIA NeMo 2.0 to curate data and train, fine-tune, or deploy LLM, multimodal, and speech models
quote: using NVIDIA NeMo 2.0 to set up environments, curate data, and train, fine‑tune, or deploy large language models, multimodal (audio‑vision‑language) models, and speech AI systems
